title: RI-MTH02 R5 regression: arena_flat with NO enemy at all, scripted movement and attacks. The W1-00 critic's counter-example to AM-W1-00-01, made permanently runnable.
note: There is deliberately no spawn op. The W1-00 verdict §2.2 ran R5 here and it failed with `events[i].f` as the ONLY differing field — a second absolute frame index the rung forgets to re-base, and nothing to do with idle animations. AM-W1-00-02 names it. R4 on this scenario is EXPECTED to report `prng_never_drawn`: with no entity there is nothing seeded, and a scenario that never draws cannot demonstrate seed sensitivity. That refusal is the discriminator AM-W1-00-C1 asks for, working.
